description:
ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US with thousands of opportunities, enabling students to win more scholarships with less effort directly in ChatGPT.

Browse personalized scholarship matches based on your background. View detailed information about each scholarship including award amounts, deadlines, requirements, and credibility scores to help you choose opportunities with the highest chances of winning.

Key features:
- Apply to scholarships without leaving ChatGPT
- Access to the largest US scholarship database
- Personalized scholarship recommendations with AI
- Detailed scholarship info with credibility scores
- Track application status and deadlines
- Access no-essay and quick-apply opportunities

From high school to graduate school, ScholarshipOwl makes it easy to discover funding and complete applications without jumping between websites or filling out repetitive forms.
